Strategy: When the item is large, aim for the middle of the feasible residual range instead of the tightest bin, keeping very tight and very loose bins in reserve; small items still use Best Fit. It may help by balancing bin usage for large items, but may fail if the middle residual is rarely the right size for what follows.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [-abs(r - (min(bins) + max(bins)) / 2) if item >= 50 else -(r - item) for r in bins]
```
